defaults.composition: One clear anchor in the middle ground with readable surroundings

shots.subject: A lone weathered larch turned gold on a grassy plateau knoll, frost on the grass around its base, a granite boulder beside it and pale fog lying in the valley behind
shots.composition: Eye-level from the side, the larch standing on the right third of the frame on its knoll, frosted grass across the foreground and the fog valley filling the left behind
shots.motion_elements: the valley fog and the larch branches

shots.subject: A large lichen-covered granite tor rising from dry summer moor grass, a few rowan saplings at its foot
shots.composition: Camera low at the foot of the tor looking up, the stacked granite filling the center and rising against a warm sky with drifting clouds, grass tips along the bottom edge
shots.motion_elements: the moor grass and the drifting clouds

shots.subject: A small dark tarn in a hollow of the moor in autumn, rust sedge along its edge, a flat schist slab on the near shore and a russet hillside on the far bank
shots.composition: Eye-level just above the water, the far bank and its mirror image meeting at the center line in near symmetry, the slab in the lower foreground and mist over the far bank
shots.motion_elements: the drifting mist and faint ripples on the tarn

shots.subject: A clear upland stream over rounded gray cobbles, cushion dark olive moss and dry summer tussock grass leaning over its banks
shots.composition: From the bank slightly above, the stream running diagonally from the lower left to the upper right corner, cobbles on the near bank and a grassy slope behind
shots.motion_elements: the flowing stream and the tussock grass

shots.subject: A cluster of knee-high, wind-flattened dwarf mountain pines creeping low over a rocky rise dusted with first snow, their flat crowns combed one way by the wind, no tall trees anywhere
shots.composition: Camera low below the rise looking up, the low dark pine mats along the crest against a pale grey sky with soft drifting cloud, snowy rocks across the lower third
shots.motion_elements: the pine needles and the drifting clouds

shots.subject: A wind-bent rowan with muted rust berries growing from a crack in a pale quartzite outcrop on an open hillside, soft rounded hills behind
shots.composition: Seen past a soft out-of-focus clump of brown bracken at the lower left edge, the rowan and its outcrop in the middle ground right of center, the hills behind
shots.motion_elements: the rowan leaves and the bracken fronds

shots.subject: A shallow bog pool with clumps of white cotton grass, dark peat hummocks and a low mist line over the flat moor behind
shots.composition: Eye-level from the side, the cotton grass clump and its pool on the left third, the flat moor and the mist line stretching across the right
shots.motion_elements: the cotton grass heads and the low mist line

shots.subject: A solitary stone pine standing on the far edge of an alpine shelf, dry summer grass on the shelf and layered blue ridges in haze behind
shots.composition: Telephoto from across a valley with no foreground, the distant pine small on the shelf edge left of center and the ridges stacked behind it
shots.motion_elements: the pine branches and the drifting haze

shots.subject: A moss-covered glacial erratic boulder on a heather slope with first snow lying on its top and the faint outline of spruces in the fog beyond
shots.composition: Seen past snow-dusted heather stems close along the bottom edge, the boulder in the middle ground on the left third, fog and faint spruces behind
shots.motion_elements: the drifting fog and the heather stems

shots.subject: A small step waterfall on a moorland brook spilling over a ledge of dark sandstone between banks of bronze autumn bracken
shots.composition: Viewed from the side, the brook and its ledge running diagonally from the upper left to the lower right, bracken lining both banks
shots.motion_elements: the spilling water and the bracken fronds

shots.subject: A juniper shrub spreading over a flat granite slab with rain puddles in the rock hollows reflecting the sky
shots.composition: Looking down about 45 degrees from standing height on the slab, the juniper in the upper half, the puddles across the lower half and the slope edge at the top
shots.motion_elements: the rippling puddles and the juniper sprigs

shots.subject: A worn earth path crossing a rounded summit with old snowbanks lying beside it, short brown grass and gray cloud resting on the next summit
shots.composition: Eye-level from beside the path, the path running horizontally across the lower middle, one snowbank on the left third and the cloud-capped summit behind
shots.motion_elements: the resting cloud and the short grass tufts

shots.subject: A thawing peat pool on a flat moor, the ice gone from its middle and a snowy rounded hill beyond under a pale dawn sky
shots.composition: Low at the pool edge, the hill and its reflection in symmetry across the center of the frame, a thin ice rim along the lower edge
shots.motion_elements: the faint ripples in the open water and the thin high clouds

shots.subject: A weathered limestone ledge on a green summer plateau with fresh green feather grass growing from its cracks and an old pine stump beside it, in midsummer with every tree and slope behind green
shots.composition: Looking down about 40 degrees from the ledge top, the cracked pale stone and grass tufts filling the lower two thirds, the upland basin in warm haze across the top
shots.motion_elements: the feather grass tufts

shots.subject: The dark edge of a pine stand on a high meadow of rust-colored autumn grass with mist streaming between the trunks
shots.composition: Seen past a few soft out-of-focus grass stems across the bottom foreground, the pine edge filling the middle right and the open misty meadow on the left
shots.motion_elements: the streaming mist and the meadow grass

shots.subject: A rocky ridge spur fading up into cloud, a few stunted spruces clinging to its side and new snow on its ledges
shots.composition: Telephoto across a gap with no foreground, the spur rising from the lower right up into the cloud on the left
shots.motion_elements: the cloud wrapping around the spur

shots.subject: A thin moorland stream braiding through dark-mossed stones in midsummer, bright green sphagnum and green heather on its banks and a green hill behind, no brown, orange or rust-colored plants anywhere
shots.composition: From slightly above on the bank, the rill crossing diagonally from the bottom right to the top left, moss banks on both sides and the hill behind
shots.motion_elements: the braiding stream

shots.subject: A tall perched boulder standing on a ridge crest with late snow around its base and dry grass tufts on the crest
shots.composition: Camera low to one side of the base looking up, the boulder filling the center, lit from the side by the low evening sun so one face is warm and the other in soft natural shadow, a calm pale evening sky behind with a few streaked clouds, snow along the lower edge; the sun itself is outside the frame
shots.motion_elements: the dry grass tufts on the crest

shots.subject: A clump of dwarf birch with wet burnt copper leaves on an open tundra slope, a shallow rain pool beside it and low ridges under clearing cloud
shots.composition: Eye-level from the side, the birch clump on the left third, the rain pool to its right and the ridges across the background
shots.motion_elements: the birch leaves and the clearing clouds

shots.subject: A curving bank of muted rust bilberry and bronze heather on a hillside, a lichen-crusted boulder midway along it and shadowed slopes with sunlit ridges beyond
shots.composition: The bank sweeping diagonally from the lower left to the upper right, the boulder at the center of the line and the slopes beyond
shots.motion_elements: the heather and the bilberry leaves

shots.subject: A gray scree slope with tongues of old snow reaching down through it and a small meltwater trickle between the stones
shots.composition: From the top of the slope looking down about 45 degrees, the scree and snow tongues filling the frame and mist lying below
shots.motion_elements: the meltwater trickle and the mist below

shots.subject: A single distant rounded summit with autumn-brown flanks and a thin line of first snow near its top, a soft rain shower veil drifting past its shoulder
shots.composition: Telephoto isolation of the one summit in the center of the frame, the rain veil to one side, no foreground
shots.motion_elements: the drifting rain veil and the cloud shadows on the flanks

shots.subject: A short granite cliff band above a grassy slope, a few mountain pines on its rim and fresh snow on its ledges
shots.composition: Camera low on the slope looking up, the cliff band across the upper half, the pines on the rim against mist and the grass across the lower third
shots.motion_elements: the mist over the rim and the slope grass

shots.subject: A flat basalt outcrop with rainwater pooled in a long hollow, tufts of tawny mat grass around it and a rust autumn hillside with white cumulus beyond
shots.composition: Low at the pool, the hillside, the clouds and their reflection in near symmetry across the frame, the dark rock lip along the bottom edge
shots.motion_elements: the pool surface and the drifting clouds

shots.subject: A far granite tor on a snow-patched summit plateau, old snow drifts against its base and clean blue sky behind
shots.composition: Telephoto from a neighbouring hill with no foreground, the tor on the right third of the frame on the plateau skyline, empty sky to its left
shots.motion_elements: the passing clouds

shots.subject: A wet thawing plateau with meltwater pools and snow patches, seen through the dripping twisted branches of a krummholz pine
shots.composition: Seen past dark twisted pine branches close along the top and left edges, the plateau with its pools and snow patches in the middle ground
shots.motion_elements: the pine needles and the ripples on the meltwater pools

shots.subject: A few large golden tussocks emerging from a thin layer of first snow on a gentle slope, each long blade a separate loose strand bending in the wind, snow lying naturally between them
shots.composition: Looking down about 45 degrees on the slope, the tussocks scattered across the snowy ground and the slope fading toward a gray skyline at the top
shots.motion_elements: the tussock blades
